other_key_rules: Not more than one child of same parents; one-time assistance; cannot receive another award/same or higher level award under scheme
institution_rule: Reputed universities/institutes abroad; merit priority includes top 1,000 QS-ranked institutions

other_key_rules: Regular and full-time M.Phil/Ph.D; eligible institution categories specified in guideline
institution_rule: UGC 2(f)/12(B); eligible deemed universities under Section 3; Central/State Government grant institutions; Institutes of National Importance

income_rule: Family income from all sources <= Rs.6,00,000/year; orphan supported by guardian: income criteria do not apply

institution_rule: Premier institutions and courses approved/notified by Ministry of Tribal Affairs

scheme: Post Matric Scholarship for ST Students
eligible_courses: Class XI onward to Post Graduation in recognized post-matric/post-secondary courses

other_key_rules: Passed Matriculation/Higher Secondary or higher examination; valid Scheduled Bank account linked with Aadhaar and mobile; no other scholarship; recognized course/institution
